Browser upload limit is 500 MiB; presign only validates audio MIME. Upload creates metadata but does not start transcription automatically.
ASR without DASHSCOPE_API_KEY uses mock results; this does not provide mocked OSS configuration. Some local HTTP cases accept expected configuration-error statuses.
Word playback requires original ASR JSON archived in OSS; archival is best-effort. Summary failure is independent of transcription completion.
Native recorder defaults to dual-track; upload attempts single-track downmix and falls back to the original on failure. Native config stores the Token in JSON, not Keychain.
Teams meeting detection defaults on, is optional and uses confirmation prompts before recording actions.
JSON backup includes settings and device token hashes, excludes OSS files and Worker secrets; import merges/updates by ID.
Recording APIs check user ownership, but Storage scans the entire OSS bucket and cleanup has no separate administrator role.
Backy pull webhook triggers a new push, not data restore. Machine requests need suitable Cloudflare Access edge policies before application auth.
Test environment OSS_BUCKET is still lyre; real credentials require a separate external bucket. Production migration files are in packages/api/migrations; Wrangler config does not set migrations_dir.
Release deploys main only after CI success, without D1 migrations or automatic DMG attachment; no deploy:test command.
